notes: Techo (VDTI) is the current Phnom Penh airport; VDPP is closed, so it is not listed. The Cambodian eAIP (aim.cats.com.kh) needs a log-in, so no AD 2 data could be verified. A Cambodian government page (Economic Diplomacy unit, 20 Oct 2025, reprinting a Kiripost article) gives a 4,000 m x 60 m runway, about 20-26 km south of Phnom Penh, managed by CAIC with VINCI Airports; this is a news reprint, not the AIP, so it is not used as a fact.
